messages.subject: Reading in a .dat file in simulation
messages.subject_clean: Reading in a .dat file in simulation
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

I'm running a multilevel latent growth model simulation using MplusAutomation. I would like to read in a .dat file for my population and coverage values as part of the MONTECARLO command.
I've written a .txt file to create the models which works fine. But when I run the models, I get an error that the file used for my population and coverage cannot be found--which makes sense because I haven't generated that file with the create models command. I've tried specifying the entire path (read in from a different folder) for population and coverage, but it doesn't seem to work.
Any advice?

Thanks,
Melissa

messages.subject: Compiling Tech9 Results
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

I've found this google group to be really helpful in figuring out how to use MplusAutomation. I've used the syntax that's been posted to this group to compile my parameters and summaries into tables and it's working well.
However, I encounter issues when trying to compile the Tech9 results across my simulation results.

Here's the code I've been using:

All_Output <- readModels("~/Documents/mplus_data_gen/simulation")
sum_tech9 <- do.call(dplyr::bind_rows, lapply(1:length(All_Output), function(m) {
  df <- All_Output[[m]]$tech9
  df$model <- names(All_Output)[m]
  return(df)
}))

I get an error:
Error in bind_rows_(x, .id) :
  Argument 1 must be a data frame or a named atomic vector, not a list/mplus.tech9

I think this is because Tech9 results aren't numerical so it's giving me the error message. I'm hoping someone can help me out with getting my tech9 results. I'm relatively inexperienced with R/Dplyr and appreciate any help I can get.

Thanks!
Melissa
